title: Pattern Metadata
description: Schema for template/flow-level governance rules. Encodes composition constraints that span multiple components within a defined UI pattern — constraints that cannot be expressed in any single component's metadata.

$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema for IDE validation and autocomplete.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this pattern (e.g. 'checkout-flow').

description.description: What this pattern represents and why it needs flow-level governance.

steps.description: Ordered steps that make up this flow. Each step carries its own composition constraints.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this step (e.g. 'order-confirmation').

description.description: What happens in this step and what the user is trying to accomplish.

composition.description: Composition rules for this step — constraints that apply to the full set of rendered components, not any individual component in isolation.

maxPrimaryCTA.description: Maximum number of primary CTAs permitted to be visible simultaneously in this step.

notes.description: Narrative guidance for this step's composition rules.

required.description: Components that must be present in this step's composition.

forbidden.description: Component configurations that must not appear in this step.

aiHints.description: Hints for AI agents consuming this pattern. Indicates scope and how to apply the rules.

scope.description: The level at which rules in this file must be validated. 'template' = the full multi-step flow; 'page' = a single page; 'section' = a region within a page.

enforcementLevel.description: 'strict' = violations must be flagged as errors; 'advisory' = violations should surface as warnings.

keywords.description: Terms that trigger this pattern during intent matching.

notes.description: Natural language guidance for AI agents on how to apply these rules holistically.

compositionEntry.description: A component constraint entry — describes which component, in what configuration, and at what quantity.

component.description: PascalCase component name this constraint applies to (e.g. 'Button', 'Modal').

variant.description: The specific variant this constraint targets. Omit to apply to all variants.

quantity.description: How many instances of this component (with the given variant) are permitted or required across the full step composition.

label-hint.description: Suggested label text for this component instance. Informational only — not enforced.

reason.description: Why this entry is required or forbidden. Always include for forbidden entries.
